title: Midnight Census Card: Leave-Day Counting for Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations
content:
**Census desk reference — Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations.** Leave days on every tier are counted by the midnight census: a day is a leave day when the resident is away at midnight.

| Counting term | Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed | Medicaid Therapeutic Leave Reserved Bed | Private Pay Hospital Leave Bed Hold | Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold | Medicare Skilled Stay Hospital Leave Bed Hold | Medicare Skilled Stay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Leave day rule | absent at the midnight census | absent at the midnight census | absent at the midnight census | absent at the midnight census | absent at the midnight census | absent at the midnight census |
| Departure day is a leave day when away at midnight | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Return day is a leave day | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Emergency-room visit or outing ending before midnight creates a leave day | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| A night in hospital outpatient observation is a hospital leave day | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| How held days are booked | per service month and day payer | per service month and day payer | per service month and day payer | per service month and day payer | per service month and day payer | per service month and day payer |

Held days are booked per service month and per day payer, posted at month end or when the leave ends.

**Worked census (hypothetical).** A resident leaves at 09:00 on a Thursday and comes back at 15:00 the following Monday. Away at midnight on Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday, the resident has four leave days; Monday, the return day, is not one. A resident who goes to an emergency room at 18:00 and is back at 23:10 the same evening has no leave day. A resident kept overnight in hospital observation is away at that midnight, and the day counts as hospital leave.
